preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix) and all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: matrix is a non-empty rectangular list of lists, where all rows have the same length

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(cell, str) and len(cell) == 1 and cell.islower() for cell in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: every cell in matrix is a single lowercase alphabetical character
matrix has at least one row and one column

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for path in get_all_paths(matrix) if is_palindrome(path)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: return_value equals the count of all valid paths from top-left to bottom-right (moving only right or down) that form a palindrome, modulo 10^9 + 7
